lines.text: Weekend plans? Mine are none.
I listened to an old album all evening.
I just moved into the flat above the bakery.
I cleaned out my wardrobe. Found three scarves.
My grandmother taught me to fish on this river.
I finally cleaned my desk. It won't last.
I'm saving for a secondhand motorbike.
I can't decide what to cook tonight.
I volunteer at the cat shelter on Saturdays.
My favourite flower is the moonflower.
I tried painting with watercolours.
Have you ever got lost in a new city?
